title.zh: 查询视频溯源水印m3u8作业
title.en: Query video tracing watermark m3u8 job

descriptions.zh:
- 目前数字水印相关接口只支持华东2（上海）、华北2（北京）地域使用。

- 经过视频溯源水印m3u8作业处理生成的绝对路径的m3u8文件签名鉴权有效期为24小时（从处理完成开始计时），请尽快查询，签名鉴权过期后将无法查询到该次作业的水印信息。如签名鉴权过期后需要，请重新提交视频溯源水印m3u8作业。

- 最大可查询历史数据（Job信息）的时间范围为6个月。
descriptions.en:
- Currently, digital watermarking-related APIs are only supported in the China (Shanghai) and China (Beijing) regions.  

- The signed authentication for the absolute path of the m3u8 file generated by the video tracing watermark m3u8 job is valid for 24 hours (starting from the time processing completes). Please query it as soon as possible. After the signed authentication expires, the watermark information for that job will no longer be accessible. If you need the information after expiration, you must resubmit the video tracing watermark m3u8 job.  

- The maximum time range for querying historical data (job information) is 6 months.
